verdict.rationale: CIPO runs account-based online services such as MyCIPO Patents and online trademark filing, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle controls. It covers only filing, search, bulk data, renewal and document retrieval, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
